Teun #Koopmeiners will have his past in #AZJuve.He will present the match in the pre-match press conference alongside Luciano #Spalletti. Appointment at 7:10 PM.@junews24com[Marco Baridon]

👀 "#Carnevali would like to reduce the number of foreign players at #Juventus and give more space to young Italian players.The idea: build a solid core and reinforce the sense of belonging.Among the monitored profiles are #Palmisani and #Ndour.#Raimondo, evaluated at the beginning, will be out for 2/3 months due to an injury.The club's line already seems mapped out: start over from a young, Italian base."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

Notes from the pre-match training session for #AZJuve✅ #McKennie is there. Separate warm-up (along with #Cabal) and then joined the group for the training match ✨ #NextGen players #Elimoghale (fresh off a renewal), #Owusu, #Merola and #Pagnucco were aggregated to the squad. 🆕 #Çelik continues to train separately. #Ekhator appeared very smiley, this will be his first European call-up.@junews24com[Marco Baridon]

🆙❗️"Before communicating the need to go into a training retreat, #Carnevali spoke directly to the players. The goal was to clear the air, confront the issues and explain that everyone is being monitored, moving beyond just tactical work and the coach's duties. Against #Napoli, the club saw a cohesive team with a single line of thought: this was exactly what had been missing. It is a first strong signal of the determination to emerge from this difficult moment."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀⚠️ "#KoloMuani could end up on the bench, with #Woltemade starting both on Thursday and Sunday, developing a tactical solution with an additional attacking winger. At this moment, the Frenchman is unable to play even as a winger."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇺🇸❓#McKennie could miss the match against #AZ, but a call-up is still not ruled out: he could travel with the team to support the group, potentially representing an emergency option from the bench. The final decision will be made tomorrow, with #Spalletti and the staff assessing his condition and prioritizing caution to avoid any relapses.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
